capabilities: Track last-edited time for every block in a note
Display timestamps right of the document with configurable relative-date rules
Restore original timestamps on undo/redo and migrate them by block hash after external edits
Roll back clobbered timestamps from one-generation backups
extras: README includes a full Chinese translation plus developer-facing release and localization instructions; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows only file-level modification times, so there is no way to see when individual blocks like paragraphs, headings, lists or tables were last changed.
summary: Block-level edit-time tracker that records and displays when each block in a note was last edited, with labels aligned to the right of the document.
